city_center.name: Historic Park City Main Street
city_center.landmark: Park City Mountain base + Historic Main Street district (Old Town), Wasatch Range behind
city_center.notes: Historic Main Street is a National Register mining-town business district; the Park City Farmers Market sets up at the base of Park City Mountain Resort (Canyons Village) Wed 11-5 through mid-October. McLeod Creek runs through the Wasatch Back valley below Old Town. sources: Park City Main Street Historic District (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Park_City_Main_Street_Historic_District); park-city-84098.json hyper_local_sources.

cultural_notes: silver-mining heritage town: Historic Main Street preserves Victorian, Queen Anne and Mission/Spanish Revival storefronts from the boom; an anti-chain-store ordinance keeps Main Street independent (source: Park City Main Street Historic District, en.wikipedia.org; westernartandarchitecture.com)
ski-and-snowboard civic identity: hosted 2002 Winter Olympics alpine/nordic events, hosts Sundance Film Festival on Main Street each January (source: sltrib.com Park City Main Street)
